decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Heritage Statement, Flood Risk Assessment number 614, drawing no's P01, P02, P03, P04, P05, P07, P08, P09, P100, P101, P102, P103, P104, P201, P202, P203, P204, P205, P206 & P500, and Design and access statement dated August 2011 - all received 31/03/16; drawing no's P10B & P12B received 10/08/16; drawing no's P06B, P11B & P13C received 31/08/16) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples/detailed specifications of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted have been submitted, to include: wall and roof finishes to the rear extensions; brickwork and pots to raised chimney; and glass, zinc sheeting and sliding doors to mansard extension. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.

Condition : 4 - Details of all new external doors, door frames, window frames and glazing bars, including samples if so required, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced. Such details shall indicate, at a scale of not less than 1:20, the longitudinal and cross-sectional detailing of new windows, cill
and lintel detailing, and means of opening. All new window frames, glazing bars and external door frames shall be of timber construction, white painted, with (if any) trickle vents concealed and thereafter so maintained. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.

Condition : 5 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 6 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nibs and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
Condition : 7 - The rainwater goods, vents and soil pipes utilised in the development hereby permitted shall be cast iron and coloured black and thereafter so maintained.

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until elevation drawings of new partition walls and 1:20 scale drawings of all new joinery have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly. New joinery should be a sympathetic design in relation to historic character and be white painted timber.
Condition : 9 - All new or disturbed work to the interior and exterior of the building shall be finished or made good to match the existing.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until detailed drawings of plumbing/service routes and their housing have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place until details showing that the new cupboards in bedroom 3 (second floor level) shall be free standing or fitted with small safety attachments, to avoid damaging the historic fabric. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.

Condition : 12 - No development shall take place until details of the extended patio area have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours and hard surfacing material. The approved details shall thereafter be implemented accordingly.
description: Demolition of existing ground floor rear conservatory, removal of existing rear staircase housing and skylight and erection of ground, first and second floor rear extensions, roof extension with roof terrace and internal alterations
